nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘High’ category. All other respiratory viruses we monitor (SARS-CoV-2, RSV, Influenza A, Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide. https://t.co/sisICKgmTl

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘High’ category with medium concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/YKRMI7GdJv

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, the LP.8.1 variant (a descendant of KP.1) in brown (62%) & other KP.1 variants in light green (2.8%) make up around 65% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/A33zK5n6Qe

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 8% and 15% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/JYReelk6ol

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 27 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 8 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 5/30/25, 17 states reported infected cattle herds. The most recent wastewater detections have been in AK, NC & NJ. https://t.co/XnwJB1QzIv

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 2% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/sma4Qvh92d

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally because it is not in onset. 42% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/GwK6rlgcJC

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘Medium’ category nationally with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/CPpm5goi9R

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: Monitoring began for measles, parvovirus, and was resumed for rotavirus and human adenovirus group F. https://t.co/TSOqLfCTrF
